## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text combines [師會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%9C%83) Shīhuì's treatise on the *tóng jiào yī chéng* 同教一乘 ("shared-teaching One-Vehicle") doctrine — a key Huáyán-school doctrinal position concerning the relation of the *Avataṃsaka*'s One-Vehicle teaching to the Three-Vehicle teachings of the other Mahāyāna scriptures — with [希迪](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%8C%E8%BF%AA) Xīdí's annotation. Per DILA A000487, Xīdí's annotation is dated *Jiātài* 嘉泰 2 (1202).

**Abstract**

The composite work covers the period from Shīhuì's mature activity (c. 1145 – 1170) through Xīdí's annotation (1202). The bracket adopted here (1145 – 1218) reflects this maximum window. The doctrinal substance is one of the most important controversies in mature Sòng Huáyán-school doctrinal study: the *bǐn jiào* 別教 ("separate-teaching One-Vehicle") versus *tóng jiào* 同教 ("shared-teaching One-Vehicle") distinction that Fǎzàng had introduced in *[the Wǔ jiào zhāng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0074)*.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1016) collection.
